subject.title: fix(memory): search by filenames and paths

question: Should `dropMemoryPathFtsTriggers` and `ensureMemoryPathFtsTriggers` become permanent public plugin SDK API as part of this fix?
rationale: Cross-package publication needs shared schema behavior, but the scoped SDK policy discourages exposing host implementation mechanics without an intentional long-term compatibility contract.

options.title: Keep lifecycle internal
options.body: Expose a narrower memory-publication capability and retain trigger mechanics inside the memory host SDK.

options.title: Approve public helpers
options.body: Accept the three exports as supported API with explicit documentation, compatibility tests, and ownership.

recommendation.title: Keep lifecycle internal
recommendation.body: Expose a narrower memory-publication capability and retain trigger mechanics inside the memory host SDK.
